evidence_index.claim: Startup commit and branch were exact before work.
The direct remote branch matched startup at launch.
No local container/VM CLI is installed on the commissioned host.
sandbox-exec is present but unqualified and probe-only.
evidence_index.observed: /usr/bin/sandbox-exec exists; no-arg usage exits 64; only probeSandbox uses it; probe reports file/credential denials and network NOT_RUN; runtime wiring absent

evidence_index.claim: Controller secrets are same-UID files, not protected from a same-UID candidate.
evidence_index.observed: all owner matthewsmith:staff; shared-runtime 0700; keys/DB 0600; candidate uid 501

evidence_index.claim: Controller loop receipts prove scheduling/receipts, not protected capture.
R09 independent review established same-interpreter capture forgery.
evidence_index.observed: P1 actual 41 reported as 42; P2 substituted source with benign digest; both accepted; P5 self-root accepted; D7 crash

evidence_index.claim: The R09 supervisor parent reads a child-authored observation and seals it.
evidence_index.observed: LocalNativeSupervisor.observe writes config/wrapper in temp dir, child writes observation.json, parent reads it and HMAC-seals payload

evidence_index.claim: Native C11 owner callables exist but are not a separately pinned protected runtime.
